decisions.decision: Person-backed resources reference PC2 Party; no duplicate person identity.
Optional authenticated association remains separate from Resource and grants no operational meaning by itself.
Legacy user/branch references map through PC5 membership and PC1 structural mappings only when explicitly adopted.
Operational labels and historical display evidence may bridge to SO5 classifications without becoming security roles.
Preserve unchanged; SO5 creates no wages, commissions, payroll or financial truth.
R6/source-specific convergence retires free-form writers after explicit mapping acceptance.
